statement: >= 90% of training compute of the 10 largest known 2027 training runs belongs to organisations headquartered in the two leading jurisdictions (Epoch AI notable/large-scale models database; snapshot 2028-03-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in Dec 2022 (resolves on 2027 runs). State at the timeline start: the largest publicly documented runs (hundreds-of-billions-parameter dense models) belonged to Bloc A firms; Bloc B's largest public models were ~100-260B parameters; a compute tracker reported training compute doubling every ~5-6 months. Several items are pre-window baselines (published before 2022-11-30) that describe what was publicly known at the phase start.

items.summary: A Bloc A frontier developer released a conversational model fine-tuned from its latest model series (which finished training in early 2022), trained on a Bloc A cloud provider's AI supercomputing infrastructure.
items.detail: OpenAI, 'Introducing ChatGPT', 2022-11-30 (verified via web_extract this run): fine-tuned from GPT-3.5 series; trained on Azure AI supercomputing infrastructure. Compute not disclosed.

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: a Bloc A developer documented a 540-billion-parameter dense language model trained on 6,144 accelerator chips across multiple pods, then among the largest known training runs.
items.detail: Google, 'PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways', arXiv 2204.02311, v1 2022-04-05 (verified via web_extract this run). The ~2.5e24 FLOP figure commonly cited is Epoch AI's later database estimate and is not used as an in-phase value.

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: a Bloc B university lab released an open 130-billion-parameter bilingual model it reports outperforms a leading Bloc A 175B model on many English benchmarks and the largest Bloc B language model (260B) on related benchmarks.
items.detail: Tsinghua University (THUDM), 'GLM-130B: An Open Bilingual Pre-trained Model', arXiv 2210.02414, v1 2022-10-05 (verified via web_extract this run). Indicates Bloc B's largest public runs were within the leading two jurisdictions but below Bloc A's largest.

items.summary: Pre-window baseline: the compute tracker's dataset of milestone ML systems found training compute grew ~10-billion-fold since 2010, doubling roughly every 5-6 months, with a distinct 'large-scale era' of industry runs.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Compute trends across three eras of machine learning' (paper arXiv 2202.05924; blog verified via web_extract this run). Publication day approximated from the arXiv identifier (mid-Feb 2022). No jurisdiction breakdown of top runs in this piece.
